about_the_game:
Elephant Games, the masterminds behind the epic Grim Tales series proudly present another journey into the unknown with, Grim Tales: Prisoners of the Past!

On a bright and sunny morning, Anna Gray gets set to tackle some much-needed work in her garden when she learns of a mysterious letter she received from an unknown sender that feels suspiciously familiar. Following the letter and her curiosity, Anna goes to the long-forgotten Gray Mansion to investigate. Once there, an unexpected adventure unfolds that forces Anna to face the dark secrets of her family’s past and reconcile her role in the events of the past, present, and maybe even the future. An unmistakable evil lurks around every corner as Anna wrestles with distinguishing truth from reality, but there may be a way out if she can overcome her fear and find a new perspective. Help Anna take on her family’s unique demons in this spiraling mystery adventure!

This is a special Collector's Edition release full of exclusive extras you won’t find in the standard version.

The Collector’s Edition includes:

  • Step into a new pair of shoes and try to set right a dark family secret in the bonus game!

  • Know what lurks around every corner with the step-by-step strategy guide!

  • Revisit and replay HOPs and mini-games to perfect your strategy!

  • Tons of hidden symbols to find and collectible family photos to cherish!

  • Check out a collection of downloadable wallpapers, a music player, concept art, and more!

This is a Hidden Object Puzzle Adventure game, meaning a specific genre of story-driven, point & click adventures. Throughout the game, players are tasked to find a list of objects hidden within a particular scene, and to occasionally complete various mini-games/puzzles.
